deliverables.title: Labs (Best 7 of 11)
deliverables.notes: 11 labs held weekly in-person (Weeks 1–7, 8–11; no labs on non-instructional days Sept 30 and Oct 13). Best 7 of 11 count, each worth 1%. Lab weeks run Sept 15–19 through Dec 1–5. Must attend registered lab section, arrive on time, actively participate, and complete or demonstrate good effort.
deliverables.ambiguity_reason: Labs span specific weeks but exact day within each week depends on registered lab section; no single weekday stated.

deliverables.title: Quiz 1
deliverables.notes: In-class, on paper, 30 minutes, closed book, no electronics allowed. Held Thursday during scheduled class time. No make-up offered; if missed, weight moves to other quiz.

deliverables.title: Quiz 2
deliverables.notes: In-class, on paper, 30 minutes, closed book, no electronics allowed. Held Thursday during scheduled class time. No make-up offered; if missed, weight moves to other quiz. If both quizzes missed and consideration approved, both weights move to final exam.

deliverables.title: Participation (iClicker / ZyBooks)
deliverables.notes: 1% per week earned via iClicker attendance/participation in Tuesday lectures OR completion of assigned ZyBooks activities; best 10 of 11–12 weeks count. Cannot exceed 10%. No make-up or extensions available.

deliverables.title: Final Exam
deliverables.notes: Cumulative, closed book, 3 hours. Scheduled by the university during the exam period December 11–22, 2025. Exact date, time, and location to be announced in November. No make-up except approved Special Examination via academic consideration.
deliverables.ambiguity_reason: Exact date and time not yet determined; scheduled by the university within the Dec 11–22 exam period.
